mapper.update: /*deleteMasterMpIfGrCreate*/ DELETE FROM IF_GRDT_EXUP WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND LEGACY_GR_NO = NVL(#{LEGACY_GR_NO},' ') AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ = NVL(#{LEGACY_GR_SEQ},' ') AND LEGACY_PO_NO = NVL(#{LEGACY_PO_NO},' ') AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = NVL(#{LEGACY_PO_SEQ},' ') AND ADD_USER_ID = NVL(#{st_user_id},' ')

/*saveMasterMpIfGrCreate*/ INSERT INTO IF_GRDT_EXUP (BUYER, LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, BUYER_ITEM_NO, STATUS, GR_DATE, GR_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, GR_AMT, ADD_USER_ID, IF_FLAG) VALUES(UPPER(TRIM(#{BUYER})), TRIM(#{LEGACY_GR_NO}), TRIM(#{LEGACY_GR_SEQ}), TRIM(#{LEGACY_PO_NO}), TRIM(#{LEGACY_PO_SEQ}), TRIM(#{BUYER_ITEM_NO}), 'C', TRIM(#{GR_DATE}), TRIM(#{GR_QTY}), NVL(#{UNIT_PRICE},0), NVL(#{GR_AMT},0), TRIM(#{st_user_id}), 'N')
